Definition
[Explicit solution of the nonhomogeneous transport equation]

↗ def:transport-explicit-solution

1. ch2:2.1.2-def-1\group Transport Equation

For $b\in \R ^n$, $g:\R ^n\to \R $, and $f:\R ^n\times \R \to \R $, define \[ u(x,t):=g(x-tb)+\int _0^t f\bigl(x+(s-t)b,s\bigr)\, ds. \] The integrand samples $f$ on the characteristic through $(x,t)$ at time $s$.
